Trace for `GET /file/users/:identifier/avatar` (another user's profile/avatar image):

- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168` (HTTP handler registered at `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124`; resolves `:identifier`, then reads `user.AvatarURL`, base64-decodes it via `parseDataURI`, and serves it as the image blob)
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715` (wraps the store lookup by username)
- `Store.GetUser` — `store/user.go:148` (checks in-memory `userCache` first, then delegates)
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136` (calls the underlying DB driver and populates the cache)
- `Driver.ListUsers` interface — `store/driver.go:47` (driver-agnostic contract implemented per backend)
- driver implementation, e.g. `DB.ListUsers` — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88` (also `store/db/postgres/user.go` / `store/db/mysql/user.go` for other backends) — runs `SELECT ... avatar_url ... FROM user WHERE username = ?` and scans the row into `user.AvatarURL` (`store/db/sqlite/user.go:151-197`)
- stored data — `user.avatar_url` column in the `user` table (schema defined in `store/migration/sqlite/0.11/00__user_avatar.sql`, current shape in `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql`; equivalent files for postgres/mysql under `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql` and `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql`)
